name: carousel-hero-stage
title: Carousel Hero Stage
description: Full-width hero carousel stage with slide track viewport, chevron triggers, and progress indicators.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Airy
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Hero Carousel Pagination: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
